sn_aia_tool.description: Use this tool to narrow down and select which customer financial account is being reported for fraud or suspicious activity. Can filter by category: 'credit_card', 'transaction' (checking/savings), or 'lending' (loan/line of credit). Returns matching accounts, masked numbers, and stores 'selected_account_sys_id' in context.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"contact_sys_id","description":"The customer contact sys_id","mandatory":false},{"name":"phone_number","description":"The customer phone number","mandatory":false},{"name":"account_sys_id","description":"The company account sys_id","mandatory":false},{"name":"account_type_filter","description":"Filter: credit_card, transaction, or lending","mandatory":false}]
sn_aia_tool.name: select_customer_financial_account
